result.stdout:
csfmt 2.1.0-rc.4 (cpu:4)

Usage: csfmt [options] paths...

    paths...              C# source file, folder, or glob pattern (ex. "src/**/*.cs")
                            '\' in glob pattern is treated as a directory separator
    --concurrency <0..1>  Scale parallelism by CPU count (default: 1.0)
    --help                Show this help
    --version             Show version

    --check               List files that would change without modifying them
                            Exit with non-zero if format or syntactic error found
    --unused              List unused members
    --loc <1..>           List members with lines of code greater than or equal to
                            Blank and readability adjustment lines are excluded
                            Multiline string literals are collapsed to 1

    --strict              Format with `dotnet format` command (folder only)
    --jb=before|after     Format with `JetBrains.ReSharper.GlobalTools` (folder only)
    --rm-comments S C     Remove comments that contain either (disabled by default)
                            S = Number of semicolons (>= 0)
                            C = Number of commas     (>= 0)
                            Zero to remove all source code comments

    --config              Show resolved config and file paths
    --discover            Preview discovered and ignored files and folders


Config (.editorconfig)

    root = true           Prevent directory traversal upwards
    charset = utf-8-bom   Add UTF-8 byte order mark (otherwise use UTF-8 w/o BOM)
    end_of_line = crlf    NOT yet supported (always normalized to LF)
